Name: Nyapu Style Portrait for Lantana (Polyamory Sweet Mod)
Author: UchaNekome
Description: Nyapu has been quite busy since the 1.6 update and I appreciate and LOVE their sprites. But with new updates come new characters and one person can't possibly keep up with EVERY new mod character since the update. The Polyamory Sweet recently added a new character. And if you were like me one morning after your typical update session and starting up the game only for a character to jump-scare you with a traditional portrait. (An obvious over-exaggeration but you get the point.) Seeing how Nyapu is in the middle of updating some MAJOR mod sprites I decided to take it into my own hands and made some Nyapu style sprites for her using Caroline as a base. She turned out really well so I felt I could share her sprites for anyone who needs it.
